parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_biotech_pdufa
parsed.strategy: Buy a dated-catalyst book: thirteen FDA PDUFA decisions between Oct 10 and Feb 12, each sized small because the CRL tail is 2-4x the approval pop, plus two Oct earnings prints (ASML Oct 14, TER Oct 27) where the revision_flow_90d is unanimously positive. I deliberately avoid the names where the evidence is negative (ALB, FLUT, SMR, OKLO, SERV, VRT) and the illiquid small caps where the 35bps cost eats the edge. I would be wrong if a broad biotech risk-off hits every binary at once, or if the FDA's first-cycle base rate (~33% for first-time filers) bites harder than the revision flow suggests.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return versus SPY, net of costs, by owning dated small/mid-cap catalysts with positive analyst revision flow.
